criteria.name: rapport_child_praise

criteria.name: diagnosing_learning_gap

evidence.speaker: PARENT
evidence.quote: What are the batch timings and fee for the 6-month track?

criteria.name: objection_handling

evidence.speaker: COUNSELLOR
evidence.quote: If I send you a crisp 60-second summary on WhatsApp

evidence.speaker: PARENT
evidence.quote: Seeing what Aarav actually did today will convince him much faster than me explaining it.

criteria.reasoning: Finds the absent father's exact question and arms the mother with a forwardable summary. Does not offer to include the father directly.

criteria.name: trial_close_next_step

evidence.speaker: COUNSELLOR
evidence.quote: I'll provisionally hold that 6th seat in Ms. Rhea's Tue-Thu 6 PM batch until 11:00 AM tomorrow.

criteria.reasoning: Specific next step with a time and owner. Seat hold is factual but its authority is not verifiable here.

criteria.name: compliance_honesty

evidence.speaker: COUNSELLOR
evidence.quote: backed by our official 14-day, 100% risk-free refund policy

criteria.reasoning: Fee verified. Refund stated without the 4-class condition; several batch and curriculum details cannot be verified from the inputs.

criteria.name: listening_talk_balance

evidence.speaker: COUNSELLOR
evidence.quote: both parents being aligned is super important

criteria.reasoning: Rep talk 46%; builds each answer on what the parent just said.

claims_check.note: Policy: 100% within 14 days only up to 4 classes attended; pro-rata after. 'Risk-free' omits this.

claims_check.claim: Batch ages 7 to 9; 5 kids enrolled, 1 seat left
Camera tilted down; Superhero Hook; 45-second story
Stage Showcase every 4th week; teacher calls each child 4-5 times
Provisional hold of 6th seat until 11:00 AM
claims_check.note: Rep's authority to hold seats not documented

compliance_flags.quote: backed by our official 14-day, 100% risk-free refund policy

strengths.text: You used the educator's real details (asteroid, gravity) so the parent knew you had watched the demo. That is the strongest trust-builder in this dataset.
Asking what the absent father usually asks turned a blocker into a task you could solve, and the parent agreed immediately.

fixes.text: State the refund with its condition so no one is surprised later.
fixes.better_line: There is a full refund in the first 14 days, as long as no more than 4 classes have been attended, and a pro-rata refund after that.

fixes.text: Invite the decision-maker in, not just a summary.
fixes.better_line: Would it help if your husband joins our call after 8:30 tonight, so he can ask me directly?

coaching.next_call_drill: When a decision-maker is absent, always offer a call that includes them, then send the summary.
